title: tk herd collect + cleanup --preview
description: cmd/tk/cmd/herd_collect.go + herd_cleanup.go. tk herd collect <tick-id> [--json]: from the manifest (internal/herd/state), verify durable results per herdr-runner.md — branch exists and has commits beyond spawn base, RESULT-<tick-id>.md present in the worktree with a final STATUS line, boundary check (git diff --name-only base...branch -- .tick/ must be empty); print a structured verdict (ready-to-merge | no-commits | missing-result | boundary-violation) with evidence paths; never merges (orchestrator merges). tk herd cleanup [<tick-id>|--epic <id>] --preview|--apply: from manifests, list exactly what would be removed (herdr workspace/worktree via worktree.remove, local branch via git branch -d semantics — refuse unmerged), refuse to touch blocked/incomplete workers (manifest + live agent state check), --preview default and --apply explicit. Cobra + legacy switch + ResetFlags per learnings. Unit tests: fake server + temp git repos covering all four collect verdicts and preview-vs-apply, unmerged-branch refusal, blocked-worker refusal.
notes: 2026-08-11 15:10 - Dispatch requirement (human-approved): every herd command must return explicit ExitError for its exit codes — never rely on GetExitCode message-substring classification (known to misread "invalid argument" dial errors as usage exit 2). Pattern established in herd_wait.go (tick 9z6).
acceptance_criteria: go test -short -count=1 ./... passes; collect verdicts and cleanup preview/apply/refusal paths covered; cleanup never removes unmerged or blocked state
